name: Dream #265
description:
‘Dream Recorder’ symbolises the multitude of  aspirations that we collectively share. 
It reminds us that no matter what life decides to throw our way, we should never give up on our dreams. 

Artists, by our very nature, are infinite dreamers that use their imagination to remake and mould the world into its existence.   

A dream ensemble of 24 musical and visual artists blend together to draw inspiration and share their creations through a component of our inspired dreams.  Each visual layer, and each of the varied musical components that make up the hybrid compositions represent how each artist has perceived and was inspired by their ‘dreams’.   Some explore themes of beauty, courage, and nostalgia while others carve their way into reality by means of abstraction and reflection. One thing is certain, imagination is deeply encoded into the lifeblood of the stream.

Each of the mints are provably unique as they compile from the assorted audio/visual layers created by these eclectic artists.   
We’ve chosen to release it as a free mint as a thank you to our supporters and fans. It features 5 legendary editions, making it a truly rare hunt for collectors. 

Artists: 
Marcotic, plutonic mind, Johnny Filter, King Debs, LUVRworldwide, Rutger van der Tas, Jetski & Lil Ski, basseado, Benza, defiantsquid, ejthek, EM!, FtrSaroth, Gert Jan-Akerboom, mardeformas, Kazuma-Ono, Okytomo, Okin, 0xMJ, ruth allen, Stina Jones, Shinji Akhirah, Silje Thorn, strayltd and theperfesser
